description: Saves the printer the person confirmed, so they can prepare prints for it. Call it only after the person said yes to this model and nozzle. It does not connect to the machine. Returns the printer as saved; its name is what the other printer tools take.
name: printer_add

catalogId.description: Copied exactly from the printer list.

nozzle.description: Nozzle size in mm, only when the person or a photo said it.

description: Connects the Bambu Lab printer this conversation is about in LAN mode. The app opens a form in this chat where the person types the printer's access code themselves, never in chat, and the call waits for them. When they submit it, the app connects and the call returns the outcome: verified (connected) or failed (with what Bambu's network plug-in reported), saying whether a code was typed or the one the app already holds was used; help_requested (the person tapped "Help me find the code" in the form and wants help finding it); or dismissed (they closed the form). Pass the deviceId of a printer in printer_connection_status's candidates; one in cloud mode cannot be connected, because LAN Only is off on it. For Moonraker or OctoPrint use printer_host_connect instead.
name: printer_bambu_connect

description: Saves a new nozzle size on a saved printer, after the person confirmed it. Returns what changed and the printer as it now is. When the open project uses this printer, its unsaved edits are dropped and their keys listed in discarded; the version saved before the change keeps them.
name: printer_change

nozzle.description: The nozzle size now on it, in mm.

description: Reads whether the printer this conversation is about can be reached over the network. For a Bambu Lab printer it starts the network search if it has not started and, until a printer of that model is heard, listens during this call for up to 30 seconds, then reports what it has found of that model. candidates are printers it knows in LAN mode, heard on the network or saved from an earlier connection, and only an attempt shows whether one answers. seen cannot be connected: reason cloud_mode means the printer is on the network and LAN Only is off on it. Reason account_only means it is on the person's Bambu account and has not been seen on the network. The app also lists every other printer it knows of and does not offer, so none is hidden: other_model is a printer of another model (detail names it); linked_elsewhere is a printer of this model already set up as another saved printer (detail names that printer); other_device is a printer of this model that is not the one this printer was set up from (detail is that device id); occupied is a printer in LAN mode whose bind state is not free. search.state listening with nothing listed means nothing was heard in the time search.secondsAgo gives, not that the printer is absent: the search goes on, and the app posts a note if a printer of this model is heard later. port_taken means another app on this computer holds the port printers announce on, so nothing can be found, whatever mode the printer is in. not_listening means nothing holds that port and this app takes it only as it starts.
name: printer_connection_status

description: Connects the printer this conversation is about to the Moonraker or OctoPrint at an address, and saves that address as its connection once the host accepts the test. The call returns once the connection has an outcome. It first tests with the API key the app already holds for that address and type, or with none, for at most 30 seconds. If the host refuses that test (Moonraker with HTTP 401, OctoPrint with HTTP 403), the app opens a form in this chat where the person types an API key themselves, never in chat, and the call waits for them: when they submit it, the app tests again with that key. The result is verified (connected and saved; for Moonraker it gives Klipper's state, which Moonraker reports whether or not Klipper can reach the printer's board), failed (with the host's or the network's own words), help_requested (the person tapped "Help me find the key" in the form and wants help finding it) or dismissed (they closed the form). It says what each host answered and which API key each test sent. Pass hostType and the address with its port when it has one. For a Bambu Lab printer use printer_bambu_connect instead.
name: printer_host_connect

address.description: The print host's address, an IP address or a name, with its port when it has one.

description: You decide which printer this is. This tool checks the printers you name against the app's printer list, shows them to the person as picture cards, and returns reference details. It saves nothing: call printer_add once the person confirms one model. alreadyYours only means settings for the same model were saved before, not the same physical printer.
name: printer_identify

catalogIds.description: 1 to 3 ids, copied exactly from the printer list.

nozzle.description: Nozzle size in mm, only when the person or a photo said it.

description: Apply an atomic settings patch immediately. Requires the sessionId and revision from a preview of the same scope, target, changes and persistAs; edits to the model since that preview do not matter, a settings change does. A process, filament or printer change is not undone by project Undo; an object override is. With persistAs the preset is saved as well, and savedAs names what it was saved as.
name: settings_apply_patch

persistAs.description: Not for object. Save the changed preset under this name, as the app's Save does: its own name overwrites it; another name saves a copy, which is used in its place from then on. A preset that comes with the app cannot be overwritten (read_only_preset): save a copy, under the name the issue suggests unless the user gave one. Without persistAs a change stays unsaved, which only the preset being edited can be.

scope.description: Whose settings. process: the print's own settings, which every object uses; that is what a request about the print means. object: one object's overrides, only when the user asks for one object to be printed differently from the others. filament or printer: that preset's own settings.

target.description: Leave out for process. object: objectId, from workspace_inspect. filament and printer: preset, the preset's exact name as workspace_inspect or the conversation gives it.

description: Read current values and their preset origin; read before previewing a patch. process reads the values every object prints with. object reads the values that one object prints with: its own override where it has one (overridden: true), otherwise the process value. filament and printer read that preset: with its unsaved changes when it is the one being edited (differsFromPreset), otherwise as saved.
name: settings_get

scope.description: Whose settings. process: the print's own settings, which every object uses; that is what a request about the print means. object: one object's overrides, only when the user asks for one object to be printed differently from the others. filament or printer: that preset's own settings.

target.description: Leave out for process. object: objectId, from workspace_inspect. filament and printer: preset, the preset's exact name as workspace_inspect or the conversation gives it.

description: Validate an atomic settings patch, and persistAs, without changing anything; use the returned sessionId and revision when applying. A setting that holds one value per extruder or nozzle takes the same number of values, separated by commas. object checks the patch as overrides on that object: settings that apply to the whole print (skirt, travel speed, spiral vase and the like) are refused with unsupported_scope, and no dependencies are predicted because the app keeps object overrides as written. A filament or printer preset that is not the one being edited changes only by being saved (not_selected without persistAs). A warning with code skipped_confirmation is a confirmation the app asks of a person who makes that change, or saves it, by hand, in its own words. The patch skips it and applies as sent, so it is yours to settle before applying: go ahead; go ahead and tell the user; or, when the answer is the user's to give (it depends on what the object is for, or it accepts a risk to their printer), ask them first. Its suggestions are the values the app's Yes would set; add them to the patch to accept them.
name: settings_preview_patch

A preset that comes with the app cannot be overwritten (read_only_preset): save a copy, under the name the issue suggests unless the user gave one. Without persistAs a change stays unsaved, which only the preset being edited can be.

description: Find a page of process, object, filament or printer settings by key, label, or description. The query may hold several words or keys, and settings matching more of them come first. writable keeps only the settings the patch tools may change; changedOnly keeps only settings with unsaved changes (for object, the object's own overrides), which with an empty query lists every one. A page is not the full list; read known keys directly with settings_get or follow nextCursor.
name: settings_search
